text:
An aimbot for a multiplayer game isn't something I can help with — it's cheating software that harms other players and violates game terms of service, regardless of how it's framed.

If you're working on something legitimate I can help with instead — like a first-person camera system, smooth input handling, field-of-view calculations for a single-player game, or general 3D math utilities — happy to do that.
